title: river_indie_gen2_owners_manual
text: RANGE ESTIMATION Range is subject to various factors such as weight of the riders and load, temperature of the surroundings, gradient on the road and riding style. The Indie estimates your available range at any point based on the above factors and updates the same in the Instrument Cluster and the River App. There can be a variation in SOC observed between two consecutive vehicle operations. This is normal and can occur due to conditions such as vehicle resting, hibernation (sleep mode), or FOTA updates running in the background. Range figures quoted in this manual and on the spec sheet are estimates for a single 48 rider under ideal conditions. 51
